overallCoordinationRisk.explanation: Comment-section astroturfing index: 79/100 (Very high). Rubric strength 0: the top 3 recommendation(s) scored 0 (commenter13), 0 (commenter16), 0 (examplefinds2) on the rubric. Coordination 100: 31 supportive comments repeat another account's short text ("nice" ×10, "good" ×7, "lo quiero" ×3, "wow" ×3). Comment realism 73: 16 of 73 endorsing comments are estimated at 50+ (unnatural text, seller or random usernames, template phrases, duplicates). Low-effort support 100: 67 of 73 supportive comments are three words or fewer or generic praise, and 9 comment(s) are nonsense filler (93%; half is ordinary, 90% counts fully). Commercial signals 51: 20 of 74 accounts praising or asking about the product have shop-style names; 1 comment(s) fish for the store owner. History contrast not measured: this platform does not give access to commenter histories, so it is left out and the other parts carry its weight. One-sided support 100: 100% of comments taking a side were supportive. Weights: comment realism 30%, low-effort support 15%, coordination 15%, commercial signals 20%, rubric 10%, history contrast 10%, spread over the parts that could be measured; one-sided support adds up to 10 points only when the rest reach 15 (+10 here). No user histories were sampled.

Interaction patterns: highest for the recommendation by exampleshop14. T4: Short, low-effort two-word comment with 82 likes, outranking more detailed recommendations in engagement. Index = share of this axis's rubric points that fired.
Not scored: the rubric cannot measure undisclosed sponsorship directly. No recommendation disclosed a commercial tie.
